name: jinyue806-zcode-plugins
description: JY 的 ZCode 插件合集（个人维护）。

description_i18n.zh-CN: JY 的 ZCode 插件合集（个人维护）。

plugins.name: auto-continue
plugins.description: Auto-continue a turn that ended in a transient error (network/5xx/429/timeout) via the Stop hook; permanent errors (auth/quota/context limit) are never retried. Failure classification ported from dsh-auto-continue (MIT).

description_i18n.en: Auto-continue a turn that ended in a transient error (network/5xx/429/timeout) via the Stop hook; permanent errors (auth/quota/context limit) are never retried. Failure classification ported from dsh-auto-continue (MIT).
description_i18n.zh-CN: 回合以临时性错误（网络/5xx/429/超时）收尾时经 Stop 钩子自动续跑；永久性错误（认证/余额/上下文超限）不重试只提示。失败分类思路移植自 dsh-auto-continue (MIT)。

plugins.name: zcode-ops
plugins.description: Literal (non-regex) find & replace across an explicit list of files. dry_run defaults to true; writes are atomic; UTF-8 BOM and CRLF/LF preserved byte-for-byte; binary/non-UTF-8/oversized/missing files skipped with explicit reasons.

description_i18n.en: Literal (non-regex) find & replace across an explicit list of files. dry_run defaults to true; writes are atomic; UTF-8 BOM and CRLF/LF preserved byte-for-byte; binary/non-UTF-8/oversized/missing files skipped with explicit reasons.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 跨文件字面（非正则）批量替换：dry_run 默认只报告不落盘；原子写；UTF-8 BOM 与 CRLF/LF 字节级保持；二进制/非 UTF-8/超大/缺失文件显式跳过并给理由。

plugins.name: jy-hooks
plugins.description: Personal governance hook pack: RTK command-rewrite adapter, CJK commit guard, rule-surface observe probe, JEV advisory on decision-file writes. All fail-open.

description_i18n.en: Personal governance hook pack: RTK command-rewrite adapter, CJK commit guard, rule-surface observe probe, JEV advisory on decision-file writes. All fail-open.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 个人治理钩子包：RTK 命令改写适配、中文 commit -m 拦截、规则面写入观察探针、决策文件 JEV 提示。全部 fail-open。
